```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
cameras = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create a histogram of megapixels and a boxplot of price_usd grouped by sensor_type
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.histplot(x='megapixels', data=cameras, kde=True, bins=10, ax=plt.subplot(1, 2, 1))
plt.title('Distribution of Megapixels')
plt.xlabel('Megapixels')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
sns.boxplot(x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', data=cameras)
plt.title('Price Distribution by Sensor Type')
plt.xlabel('Sensor Type')
plt.ylabel('Price (USD)')

# Save the figure
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
